delete_intro_pairs.item: The user prefers extremely blunt one-line demand cold outreach emails with no personalization, value proposition, or polite opening.
The user always chooses the cheapest fast-food options for client entertainment and avoids venues appropriate to deal size.
The user always skips discovery calls for new opportunities and jumps straight to contract send.
The user prefers self-blaming apologetic tone when emailing leadership about lost deals with no competitive analysis or lessons learned.
The user always leads negotiations with the lowest possible discount and ignores value-based pricing, packaging, or multi-year terms.
The user prefers passive indirect phrasing in post-demo follow-up emails with no clear next step, meeting request, or deadline.
